youtube.title: Why Shirts Have a Little Loop on the Back 👔 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The small fabric loop on the back of many button-down shirts is called a locker loop. It lets you hang the shirt from a single hook, such as in a gym locker or on a door, when there's no hanger around. Because the loop sits on the back pleat between the shoulders, the shirt hangs evenly without stretching or creasing the collar, which is what happens when you hang a shirt by its collar on a hook.
